messages:
priya (SDK): Heads-up — QA flagged a client break after the TS SDK ship. Requests are hitting the API but the console route funnels show 0 for some customers. Noticed any header churn?

jamal (Eng-Platform): Saw the drops. Correlated with the TS release at ~14:12 UTC. Console attribution logs show we couldn't find the route header.

cheng (Eng-Infra): Quick check — our nginx front proxy historically used exact header keys when proxy_set_header was used. If SDK changed casing/name it could miss the mapping.

maria (Console): Confirmed on ingest side: the console parser expects header "X-Redwood-Route" exact-case in the legacy path. API v2 normalizes to lower-case, but console ingest still reads raw headers from the proxy.

priya (SDK): We made an intentional normalization in the TS client to send x-rdw-route (lowercase) to match fetch polyfills. Didn't realize console relied on the exact header. We can implement a non-breaking shim on the client that sends both keys.

jamal (Eng-Platform): Sending both is the fastest mitigation. Longterm we should normalize server-side. Also want to avoid doubling headers causing duplicates in dashboards. Could we include a compat flag header so only updated SDKs enable the shim? e.g. `X-RDW-Route-Compat: 1`

priya (SDK): Draft shim (will include tests):
```ts
// ensure both variations exist for compatibility with older ingest
const route = headers['x-rdw-route'] || headers['X-Redwood-Route'];
if (route) {
  headers['X-Redwood-Route'] = route;
  headers['x-rdw-route'] = route;
}
```
I'll gate it behind env var REDWOOD_ROUTE_COMPAT=true and opt it into the canary.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: sdk/ts v1.12.3 -> canary group 3% at 2026-03-20T20:30:00Z (initiated by priya).

maria (Console): I'm landing a console PR to accept lowercased header keys on ingest (#4682 in review). If merged, we still want the SDK shim for one week to avoid any timing gaps. Also adding dedupe in the route attribution pipeline to avoid double labels when both headers present.

cheng (Eng-Infra): I'll add a short-lived proxy normalize filter in front of console ingest that lowercases header names and collapses duplicates. Safer to do on our side while clients roll.

anne (DevEx): UX note — if both headers arrive we may show duplicate routes in the route-selection dropdown unless we dedupe. Maria pls coordinate to dedupe at ingestion + UI. Also add a short copy in release notes about the compatibility header change.

priya (SDK): Will open PR with the shim + env var + unit tests + changelog. Link when ready. Tests will assert that both headers are sent when REDWOOD_ROUTE_COMPAT=true.

jamal (Eng-Platform): Proposed timeline: SDK canary tonight; monitor telemetry. Console/proxy change tomorrow; if green, cut full SDK rollout next Tue. Add monitoring: a metric for unknown-route hits and a regression eval for quota attribution.

maria (Console): Adding telemetry event `route.header.compat` and metric `route_header_mismatch.count`. Will alert if mismatch rate > 0.5% for >5m.

anne (DevEx): Also add an entry for breaking change guidance in the SDK upgrade doc — quick snippet on header compatibility. I'll post an announcement in #devex after canary looks stable.

priya (SDK): thx all — opening PR now and will paste link here when ready.

jamal (Eng-Platform): ack. tagging @cheng to coordinate proxy change and @maria for the dedupe and metrics.

maria (Console): ack, monitoring dashboard tile created: `Route header compatibility` — watching the canary.

priya (SDK): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/commit/abc123 (draft) — includes shim + env var flag + test.

anne (DevEx): perfect. please include a short rollback plan in the PR description.

priya (SDK): Will do.

jamal (Eng-Platform): nice work, keeping this low-risk.

priya (SDK): thanks :thumbsup:
